All the responsibilities under these regulations shall continue to be with the entity to which in-principle or final grant of Connectivity is issued, including submission of documents inter-alia for PPA or Land or Financial closure as applicable. The documents required to be submitted to the Nodal Agency shall include an authorisation issued by the entity in whose name the documents of PPA or Land or Financial Closure or COD are furnished, enabling the entity which is issued in-principle or final grant of Connectivity to furnish the same to the Nodal Agency.”
